name: The Bloom Collection
title: The Bloom Collection — Bez Ambar
description: One-stone pieces. Each ring built around a single exceptional diamond — the bloom rendered in a single petal of light. By Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
lede: One stone. Each ring built around a single exceptional diamond.
quote: Every bloom begins with one stone. The setting exists only to make that stone breathe.

spotlights.heading:
The Petal
Setting
spotlights.body: Beneath the 13-carat D-flawless pear, a ring of marquise-cut diamonds opens like petals around the pavilion, passing fire upward into the stone from below. The bloom is structural. The light is the design.

spotlights.heading:
Color
Inside Colorless
spotlights.body: A 25-carat D VS2 colorless oval, cut without bowtie, framed entirely in fancy intense pink diamonds with matching pave down the split shank. The contrast is the design. The stone sets its own condition.
